run_extract_symbols: run extract_symbols.py to extract exportable symbols from a list of library files
run_extract_symbols_microsoft: run extract_symbols.py with --mangling microsoft to extract MSVC-mangled symbols from libraries
run_extract_symbols_itanium: run extract_symbols.py with --mangling itanium to extract Itanium-mangled symbols from libraries
run_extract_symbols_output: run extract_symbols.py with -o flag to write extracted symbols to an output file
run_extract_symbols_tools: run extract_symbols.py with --tools to specify which symbol extraction tools to use
